title: Taking Off What Has Already Been Accrued on the Account
content:
Where charges have already been accrued on an Employee Meal Account within the month, an amount for them is taken off what is carried to pay, so that the same meals are not carried twice.

**Clause.** Where two or more charges have been accrued on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and no recovery has been remitted in that month, the amount taken off is summed over every charge accrued in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, because none of that run has yet been recovered. Where two or more charges have been accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and a recovery has been remitted in that month, the amount taken off is summed over the charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and the recovery remitted in that month is taken off that sum, floored at nothing. Where neither holds, no charge is summed and nothing is taken off.

## The three readings

| Charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | A recovery remitted in that month | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | None | Every charge accrued in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked |
| 2 or more | At least one | The charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, less that recovery, never below nothing |
| Fewer than 2, including none | Either | Nothing |

The count that decides the band is of charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, while the sums are taken over the stretch each band names.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

*Input.* Charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked: 3, totalling $120.00; charges accrued in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked: $305.00; recoveries remitted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked: nothing.

*Judgement.* Two or more charges in the month with no recovery remitted in it.

*Output.* $305.00 is taken off.

Had $70.00 been remitted in that month, the second band would have applied instead and $120.00 less $70.00, or $50.00, would have been taken off.
